---
title: "Nodata / Mask Reference"
subtitle: "Python & EO workflows"
format:
  typst:
    fontsize: 9pt
---

+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
| Protocol / Standard          | Nodata / Mask Standard     | Check ANY nulls/masks (Python)                 | Notes / Exceptions     |
+==============================+============================+================================================+========================+
| `np.array`                   | No built-in nodata.\       | `np.isnan(arr).any()  # float`\                | Must know convention.  |
|                              | Float: `np.nan`; Int:      | `(arr == nodata).any()  # sentinel`            | No intrinsic nodata    |
|                              | sentinel (e.g., -9999).    |                                                | concept.               |
+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
| `np.ma.masked_array`         | Boolean mask: `True` =     | `m.mask.any()`                                 | Mask stored separately |
|                              | invalid.                   |                                                | from data.             |
+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
| `pd.DataFrame`               | `NaN` / `None` / `pd.NA` / | `df.isna().to_numpy().any()`                   | `isna()` normalizes    |
|                              | `NaT` (dtype-dependent).   |                                                | all NA types.          |
+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
| SQLite                       | SQL `NULL`.                | `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE col IS    | Must check per column. |
|                              |                            | NULL);`                                        | `NULL` ≠ empty string. |
+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
| rasterio                     | Mask: 0 = invalid, 255 =   | `(src.read_masks(1) == 0).any()`\              | If no mask, may return |
|                              | valid. nodata value        | `src.read(1, masked=True).mask.any()`          | all-valid mask.        |
|                              | optional.                  |                                                |                        |
+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
| GDAL                         | Mask band: 0 = invalid,    | `(band.GetMaskBand().ReadAsArray() ==          | Alpha masks may use    |
|                              | 255 = valid. Separate      | 0).any()`\                                     | 0–255 range.           |
|                              | nodata value.              | `(arr == nodata).any()`                        |                        |
+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
| GeoTIFF                      | No universal standard.     | `(src.read_masks(1) == 0).any()`\              | Nodata metadata may be |
|                              | Often                      | `(src.read(1) == src.nodata).any()`            | absent.                |
|                              | `TIFFTAG_GDAL_NODATA` +    |                                                |                        |
|                              | mask band.                 |                                                |                        |
+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
| Earth Engine                 | Per-band mask. 0 masked,   | `img.select('B2').mask()`\                     | Must specify region +  |
| (`S2_SR_HARMONIZED`)         | >0 valid.                  | `.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.min(), roi, scale)`\ | scale. Band-specific   |
|                              |                            | `.get('B2')`                                   | masks.                 |
+------------------------------+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------+
